Hi

A question :

IF a play a Drawing Of the Beast and anyone uses as strike a End Of
Combat card the other vampire takes the damage of the Drawing of the
bEast right? Can I prevent that damage?

With the same combo-cards as before but in second round, I use a
combate End and the other une uses the Celerity card Riposte that
makes you 2 damages at the end of round (the same as the Beast one)
and he plays The Disarm how exactly did that works?

In any case can I prevent the damages of a strke after the opposing
minion plays the disarm? Or that card is played an the end of the
round?

Thkx in advance

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
dd...@zerg.com (Dday) wrote:
> IF a play a Drawing Of the Beast and anyone uses as strike a End Of
> Combat card the other vampire takes the damage of the Drawing of the
> bEast right? Can I prevent that damage?

The damage is unpreventable, by card text.

> With the same combo-cards as before but in second round, I use a
> combate End and the other une uses the Celerity card Riposte that
> makes you 2 damages at the end of round (the same as the Beast one)

Riposte's damage is done after combat (same as Catatonic Fear),
not like Drawing out the Beast.

> and he plays The Disarm how exactly did that works?

Disarm cannot be played after a Strike: Combat Ends resolves,
since there is no combat at that point.

> In any case can I prevent the damages of a strke after the opposing
> minion plays the disarm? Or that card is played an the end of the
> round?

No.
Card text says "at the end of a round".
